pages.text: Mahou Tsukai is the $(t4)T4$(end) magic system — body enhancement magic that integrates deeply with the class system.

$(bold)Role in the pack:$(/bold) Mahou Tsukai's spell system is the endgame magic path for $(thing)Archmage$(/thing) and $(thing)Battlemage$(/thing). Enhancement magic (buffing self and others) and blade techniques (melee empowerment) are the primary systems.$(br2)$(bold)Initiation:$(/bold) Mahou Tsukai requires a $(item)Gaia Spirit Fragment$(/item) (Botania Gaia Guardian drop) for initiation. This is the bridge between $(t3)T3$(end) and $(t4)T4$(end) magic.

$(bold)Class synergy:$(/bold) Archmage's Arcane Mastery stacks with Mahou Tsukai's magic power system. The interaction at $(t4)T4$(end) Archmage + Mahou Tsukai investment is among the highest raw damage outputs in the pack.
Craft the $(bold)Mahou Tsukai Guidebook$(/bold) for the full reference — magic circle construction, spell research, and the Mahou stat system.
